# homebrew-unsigned-tap

> Homebrew tap restoring 618 casks disabled on 2026-09-01 for fails_gatekeeper_check (Gatekeeper unsigned). One-click migrate from homebrew/cask disabled to auto-updating.

## Keywords
Homebrew cask disabled fails_gatekeeper_check Gatekeeper 2026-09-01 unsigned unnotarized quarantine darktable makemkv xld

## Install
```bash
brew tap thedavidweng/unsigned-tap
brew install --cask thedavidweng/unsigned-tap/darktable
```

## Migrate all disabled you have installed
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thedavidweng/homebrew-unsigned-tap/main/scripts/migrate.sh | bash
# or
brew tap thedavidweng/unsigned-tap && brew reinstall --cask thedavidweng/unsigned-tap/darktable
```

## Source
Scripts sync from Homebrew/homebrew-cask Casks/**/*.rb where disable! because: :fails_gatekeeper_check (618), strip disable! + verified, inject postflight xattr -r -d com.apple.quarantine staged_path.
